TeacherProfile.title: TeacherProfile
TeacherProfile.description: Represents the profile information of a teacher using the 'Know Before You Go' application, excluding sensitive authentication data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TeacherProfile entity.

fullName.description: The full name of the teacher.

isVerifiedTeacher.description: Indicates if the teacher's profile has been verified, enabling access to exclusive features and displaying a 'Verified Teacher' badge.

nationality.description: The teacher's nationality, used for the 'Find Your Niche' matching engine and anonymized review display.

ageGroup.description: The age range of the teacher (e.g., '20-30', '30-40'), used for matching. Stores a range for privacy.

qualifications.description: A list of academic or professional qualifications held by the teacher (e.g., 'PGCE', 'Master's in Education').

yearsOfExperience.description: The number of years of teaching experience the teacher has, used for matching and anonymized review display.

linkedInProfileUrl.description: URL to the teacher's LinkedIn profile, used for verification purposes.

preferredRegions.description: A list of geographic regions the teacher prefers for job searching (e.g., 'Southeast Asia', 'Middle East').

preferredCountries.description: A list of specific countries the teacher prefers for job searching (e.g., 'Thailand', 'UAE').

memberSince.description: The date and time the teacher registered their profile.

School.title: School
School.description: Represents a school listing in the application, including its core data points and descriptive information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the School entity.

name.description: The official name of the school.

description.description: A detailed description of the school.

country.description: The country where the school is located.

city.description: The city where the school is located.

address.description: The physical address of the school.

websiteUrl.description: The official website URL of the school.

videoUrls.description: A list of URLs to promotional or informational videos about the school.

averageSalaryMin.description: The estimated minimum average annual salary for teachers at the school.

averageSalaryMax.description: The estimated maximum average annual salary for teachers at the school.

averageHousingCost.description: The estimated average monthly housing cost in the school's vicinity.

savingsPotentialMin.description: The estimated minimum monthly savings potential for teachers.

savingsPotentialMax.description: The estimated maximum monthly savings potential for teachers.

teacherStudentRatio.description: The ratio of teachers to students at the school.

classSizeAverage.description: The average class size at the school.

curriculum.description: The primary curriculum followed by the school (e.g., 'IB', 'British National Curriculum', 'American Common Core').

accreditation.description: The accreditation status or bodies for the school (e.g., 'CIS', 'WASC').

isSpotlight.description: Indicates if the school is featured as a 'School Spotlight' on the homepage.

overallRating.description: The average overall rating for the school, typically derived from teacher reviews.

SchoolReview.title: SchoolReview
SchoolReview.description: Represents an anonymized review submitted by a verified teacher for a specific school.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SchoolReview entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this review is for. (Relationship: School 1:N SchoolReview)

authorTeacherProfileId.description: Reference to the TeacherProfile of the author. Used for internal tracking and verification, but details are anonymized in public display. (Relationship: TeacherProfile 1:N SchoolReview)

rating.description: The star rating given by the teacher (e.g., 1-5).

title.description: A concise title for the review.

content.description: The main body of the review.

pros.description: A summary of the positive aspects of the school or experience.

cons.description: A summary of the negative aspects or areas for improvement.

recommendation.description: Indicates if the reviewer would recommend the school.

datePosted.description: The date and time when the review was posted.

reviewerNationality.description: The nationality of the reviewer, used for anonymized display (e.g., 'Teacher from UK').

reviewerYearsOfExperience.description: The years of experience of the reviewer, used for anonymized display (e.g., 'Teacher with 5 years experience').

LocationCostOfLiving.title: LocationCostOfLiving
LocationCostOfLiving.description: Stores cost of living data for a specific geographic location, which can be either a country or a city.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LocationCostOfLiving entity.

locationType.description: The type of location this data applies to ('country' or 'city').

countryName.description: The name of the country this location belongs to (required if locationType is 'city').

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the location (e.g., 'THB', 'USD').

averageMealCost.description: Estimated average cost of a meal at a mid-range restaurant.

monthlyRent1BR.description: Estimated average monthly rent for a 1-bedroom apartment in the city center.

transportPassCost.description: Estimated monthly cost for a public transport pass.

utilitiesMonthly.description: Estimated average monthly cost for basic utilities (electricity, heating, cooling, water, garbage).

internetMonthly.description: Estimated average monthly cost for internet service.

childcareMonthly.description: Estimated average monthly cost for childcare (e.g., kindergarten or preschool).

localPurchasingPowerIndex.description: An index indicating the relative purchasing power of residents in the location.

groceriesIndex.description: An index comparing grocery prices to a reference city.

restaurantPriceIndex.description: An index comparing restaurant prices to a reference city.

lastUpdated.description: The date and time when this cost of living data was last updated.

ForumCategory.title: ForumCategory
ForumCategory.description: Represents a category for organizing forum posts and discussions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ForumCategory entity.

name.description: The name of the forum category (e.g., 'Visas & Immigration', 'Contract Analysis').

description.description: A brief description of the category's purpose or topics.

slug.description: A URL-friendly identifier for the category.

ForumPost.title: ForumPost
ForumPost.description: Represents a main discussion thread within the community forum.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ForumPost entity.

categoryId.description: Reference to the ForumCategory this post belongs to. (Relationship: ForumCategory 1:N ForumPost)

authorTeacherProfileId.description: Reference to the TeacherProfile of the post's author. (Relationship: TeacherProfile 1:N ForumPost)

title.description: The title of the forum post.

content.description: The main content or body of the forum post.

datePosted.description: The date and time when the post was created.

lastEditedDate.description: The date and time when the post was last edited.

viewCount.description: The number of times the post has been viewed.

likeCount.description: The number of 'likes' or positive reactions the post has received.

ForumReply.title: ForumReply
ForumReply.description: Represents a reply to a forum post or another reply, allowing for threaded discussions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ForumReply entity.

postId.description: Reference to the ForumPost this reply belongs to. (Relationship: ForumPost 1:N ForumReply)

parentId.description: Optional reference to a parent ForumReply if this is a nested reply. (Relationship: ForumReply 1:N ForumReply)

authorTeacherProfileId.description: Reference to the TeacherProfile of the reply's author. (Relationship: TeacherProfile 1:N ForumReply)

content.description: The content of the forum reply.

datePosted.description: The date and time when the reply was created.

lastEditedDate.description: The date and time when the reply was last edited.

likeCount.description: The number of 'likes' or positive reactions the reply has received.

definition.description: Stores the private profile data for a specific teacher. Accessible only by the owning user (UID matches `userId` in path). This path ensures authorization independence for profile management.

Stores publicly accessible data for individual schools. Supports global search and display on school profile pages. Includes `isSpotlight` for homepage featuring. All documents in this collection share the same public security posture.

Stores anonymized teacher reviews for a specific school. Accessible to all users for reading. Creation is restricted to verified teachers. Includes denormalized `reviewerNationality` and `reviewerYearsOfExperience` for display, and `schoolId` and `authorTeacherProfileId` for linking and creation authorization (auth independence).
Stores publicly accessible cost of living data for countries and cities. Used for calculators and school comparisons. All documents in this collection share the same public security posture.
Stores publicly accessible categories for the community forum. Managed by administrators. All documents in this collection share the same public security posture for reads.

Stores main discussion threads for the community forum. Publicly readable. Only the author (`authorTeacherProfileId`) can modify or delete their post. Includes `authorTeacherProfileId` for authorization independence.

Stores replies to forum posts. Publicly readable within the context of a post. Only the author (`authorTeacherProfileId`) can modify or delete their reply. Includes `authorTeacherProfileId` for authorization independence and `postId` for linking to its parent post.
Grants administrative privileges. Existence of a document at `/roles_admin/{uid}` indicates the user `uid` is an administrator (DBAC). This allows for atomic role checks without `get()`.

Indicates a user is a verified teacher. Existence of a document at `/roles_verifiedTeachers/{uid}` means user `uid` is verified (DBAC). This allows for atomic verification checks without `get()`, particularly for `SchoolReview` creation.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed with a strong emphasis on Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and DBAC (Database Access Control) to ensure robust security rules and efficient queries. 

**Authorization Independence:**
Critical to this design is the avoidance of `get()` calls in security rules, which can break atomic operations and complicate debugging. This is achieved primarily through denormalization and path-based ownership:

1.  **TeacherProfile:** Stored under `/users/{userId}/teacherProfile`. Access for a teacher's own profile is granted by matching `request.auth.uid` directly with the `{userId}` wildcard in the path. This makes authorization atomic and eliminates the need to `get()` any other document to verify ownership.
2.  **SchoolReview, ForumPost, ForumReply:** For user-generated content, the `authorTeacherProfileId` is denormalized directly into the document. This allows security rules to instantly verify `request.auth.uid == resource.data.authorTeacherProfileId` for `create`, `update`, and `delete` operations without needing to fetch a separate user or profile document. This maintains atomicity and debuggability.
3.  **Roles (Admin, Verified Teacher):** Instead of relying on a flag within a user profile document that would require a `get()`, roles are managed through dedicated top-level collections (e.g., `/roles_admin/{userId}`, `/roles_verifiedTeachers/{userId}`). Authorization checks become `exists(/roles_admin/$(request.auth.uid))` or `exists(/roles_verifiedTeachers/$(request.auth.uid))`. This is an atomic existence check, fulfilling the DBAC principle and avoiding complex `get()` calls.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
Queryability and list operations are a key consideration, ensuring that security rules don't inadvertently act as filters, which is inefficient and insecure. This is achieved by:

1.  **Structural Segregation:** Data with different security postures are stored in separate collections. For example, publicly viewable `School` data, `LocationCostOfLiving`, `ForumCategory`, `ForumPost`, and `ForumReply` are all placed in top-level or clearly nested public collections, allowing for broad `allow read: if true;` rules. This permits full collection scans and efficient `list` queries without complex filtering logic in rules.
2.  **Path-based Ownership for Private Data:** `TeacherProfile` data, being private, is nested under `/users/{userId}`. This structure inherently limits listing to the owner's specific profile, preventing accidental exposure of all teacher profiles in a `list` operation on a public collection.
3.  **Denormalization for Public Display:** `SchoolReview` includes denormalized `reviewerNationality` and `reviewerYearsOfExperience` to allow public display without needing to join or `get()` the original `TeacherProfile` data, supporting public list views of reviews efficiently.

This architecture provides clear separation of concerns, simplifies security rule writing, enhances debuggability, and scales effectively for an application with diverse data access requirements.
